name: Patellar Fracture
definition: Fracture of the patella from direct trauma or forceful quadriceps contraction, potentially disrupting the extensor mechanism.

investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Immobilization in extension for suitable stable fractures
amber: Displaced fractures with extensor-mechanism disruption often require surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-bhagna framework may complement recovery after stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the patella from direct trauma or forceful quadriceps contraction, potentially disrupting the extensor mechanism.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
